title: View individual peak information
description: Let the user open a details view for any peak showing all information available for it in data/peaks.json, and mark it complete from there. Only display data that exists in the dataset; do not invent or fetch extra peak information.
acceptanceCriteria: Each peak card has an accessible control (a button or link with a descriptive accessible name) that opens a details view for that peak
The details view shows the peak's number, name, region, height in metres, and completion status
The details view shows the grid reference only when the peak has one in the dataset, and shows nothing misleading when it does not
The peak can be marked complete or unmarked from the details view, and the card, overall progress and region progress update to match
The details view can be closed with a visible close control and with the Escape key, and focus returns to the control that opened it
Keyboard focus moves into the details view when it opens and cannot reach the page behind it while open
The details view is usable on a 360px-wide mobile screen and on desktop
Rendering logic for the details view is a pure function in src/peak-utils.js with automated tests, including a peak with and without a grid reference
Existing functionality and tests keep passing, and npm test exits with code 0
